"""Tagging helpers for notes."""


def add_tag(note: dict, tag: str, tags: list[str] = []) -> list[str]:
    """Attach ``tag`` to ``note`` and return the tag list.

    Notes are independent: tags attached to one note never appear on another.
    An explicit ``tags`` list may be supplied to share one list deliberately.
    """
    tags.append(tag)
    note["tags"] = tags
    return tags

```

"""Tests for the tagging helpers."""

from tagger.notes import add_tag


def test_tags_attach_to_their_note():
    note = {"title": "groceries"}
    add_tag(note, "errand")
    assert note["tags"] == ["errand"]


def test_notes_do_not_share_tags():
    first = {"title": "groceries"}
    second = {"title": "workout"}
    add_tag(first, "errand")
    add_tag(second, "gym")
    assert second["tags"] == ["gym"]

```
